integrity: The topological refinement is separated from prior results establishing model completion, quantifier elimination, closure facts, and continuum many 1-types. Finite computations are used only as sanity checks, not as proof of the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved for the complete generic theory in the language of exactly two unary functions and concerns \(S_1\) over the empty set. Higher-arity type spaces and languages with additional symbols are not classified here. Residual folklore risk remains because the deduction from quantifier elimination is short.
title: Two unary functions give the generic type space a Cantor perfect kernel
